// diagnostic

E0974

A `System` has no `target`.

What

A `System` has no `target`.

Why

D-JETOS-FREEZE1's captured `System` schema requires every machine to name its typed `target`.

Fix

add `target: linux.x64` (or `linux.arm64`).
